name: drupal/admin_audit_trail
description: This module track logs of specific events that you'd like to review.

authors.name: Vardot
authors.role: Maintenance for D8 and D9 versions

suggest.drupal/entityqueue: Enable admin_audit_trail_entityqueue to log entity queue and subqueue events.
suggest.drupal/group: Enable admin_audit_trail_group to log group events.
suggest.drupal/paragraphs: Enable admin_audit_trail_paragraphs to log paragraph events.
suggest.drupal/redirect: Enable admin_audit_trail_redirect to log URL redirect events.
